The `viola` binary. It holds the clap 4.6.7 dispatch (`src/main.rs`, one module per subcommand in `src/cmd/`) and the `run` wrapper (`src/run/`): the PTY pump, the wheel, the readiness-gate wiring and the channel server dispatch. It also owns the pinned copy + plugin write-out, the obs init (`viola::obs`: `MillisUtc`, `viola_obs_init`, the panic hook, the detail writer, the catch-site reporter `report_internal_error`; `open_role_file` and `write_detail` run `strict::check_diagnostics` on an existing `diagnostics/` folder and on the role or detail file before `ensure_private_dir` narrows anything — a symbolic link refused, a folder to the read rule, a file to the read rule, an absent path passing — and a refusal is a failed open: the writer ends at `std::io::sink`, a detail line is dropped) and the human/`--json` output modules (the `human` module: `src/human.rs`, with its phases under `src/human/` — mirror, escape, board, style (the colour layer: `Depth`, `Tokens`, `Facts`, `decide`, `read`), wait, verbs, hints —; `src/human.rs` holds the stderr refusal writer `write_refusal` behind `refuse`, the stderr `write_internal_error` (`error: internal error\n`) behind `internal_error`, and the stdout `write_result` behind `result`, each one `write_all`; called by `run`, `revive`, `verify`, `send`, `wait`, `last`, `list`, `answer`, `pause`, `release`, `plugin install` and the `main` catch site; no print macro, no `#[allow]`). `viola verify` (`src/cmd/verify.rs`) drives the one print-mode probe and then the six interactive PTY runs (`src/cmd/verify/typed.rs` and its children under `src/cmd/verify/typed/`: Run A untrusted in an OS-temp dir, Run B trusted in `<cwd>/.viola-verify-<pid>/` with compiled pastes — the probe prompt, then the long text, the tag-like text, the newline text (`PROBE_NEWLINE_PASTE`, 113 bytes, one inner LF), `/compact` (`PROBE_COMPACT_COMMAND`), `/clear` and `/mcp disable viola-probe-absent` (the `local-command-echo` row's probe, passing on a new stdout tag with no UserPromptSubmit within the confirmation window; with no readable transcript the paste skipped and the row failing), then eighth `/context` (the relied `local-command-context` row's probe, passing on a new stdout tag with no UserPromptSubmit within the confirmation window; a failing read of it is `fail`, never `absent`), each added one only into a settled input box, waited for after an added text turn and after the `/compact` turn up to `PROBE_DEADLINE` (`box_wait`: 2.1.287 shows a paste hint in the input-box literal's place for 8.0 s after a long paste) — and, once its first turn has settled and before its framing pastes, ONE `claude agents --json` read (`typed::turns::agents_read`: Run B's program, cwd the probe dir, the R8 strip, `VERSION_DEADLINE`, none once a stop is read; its capture kept in memory, never written to the captures dir; no live start added; in CI the fake agent's `agents` mode answers it), Run C's dialogs in `-dialogs/`, Run D's plan in `-plan/`, then Run E trusted in `-resume/`, resuming Run B's first session with `--resume <id>` (`viola_agent_claude::resume_args(id, false)`, the id Run B's first SessionStart `session_id` through `ledger::resume_target`; empty input, no `--settings`, ended by a kill), then last Run F, after Run E, starting in an untrusted folder for which verify wrote a trust record (the `trust-record` row passing only when the record was written, Run A showed the trust modal, and Run F's start shows no modal and the input box; verify writes that record for its own temp folder only into the Claude config file its child reads, located through `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` only when `claude_env_keep` keeps it, never creating an absent file, and removes that one record after; `run`'s and `revive`'s start, on a verified CLI, write the trust record of an untrusted spawn folder); no key into any dialog — the hidden `hook --capture --answers` arm in `src/cmd/hook.rs` answers C and D's from `PROBE_ANSWERS`), checks the relied ledger rows (`check_rows` walks `LedgerRow::relied()`: every row of `LedgerRow::ALL` on every build, the relied `local-command-echo` among them), prints the step lines (each `pass`, `absent` or `fail`) and `stamped` summary (its pass count including an absent `browser-tools-prompt`, the one relied row whose `absent` counts toward verified) and writes the stamps through `viola_state::stamps::update_stamps` (its `StampsError::StrictModes` refusal printing the home-state pair, exit 1); before its `cli` log opens it runs `viola_state::strict::check_home_tree(home, None, None)` (the home, `ledger/`, `bin/` and `plugin/`, each that exists), a refusal printing the home pair and exiting 1 with no step line, no summary and no line; a verify stopped by Ctrl-C or TERM (`cmd::verify::stop`: `SIGINT` / `SIGTERM`, installed by `viola verify` alone, its handler only setting one process-global flag that every wait of the run reads) kills and reaps the running child with no key, starts no later run, writes no stamp and exits 1 (`unable: verify was stopped before it finished` / `hint: run viola verify again to stamp this CLI`, stdout empty), its drop guards removing only the dirs, and its own trust record from the Claude config file, that run created; SIGKILL, a crash and a failed handler install keep the OS default and leave the dirs to be removed by hand; `run::version_gate` reads them at `run` start. The panic detail backtrace is raw, never-symbolised frames (`src/panic_frames.rs`). It is the only crate with anyhow (dispatch edge and the catch-site reporter) and tracing-subscriber, and it consumes only normalised events.

The verify stdout step-line and summary-line rows: the relied row count is now 25 (step lines n/25, all-pass summary 25 pass 0 fail). Flag them only where a cell holds the figure rather than the relied row count.

The verify spawn subject rows (verify-pty-probe) and the verify child set: Run B pastes /context as an eighth compiled literal in the same PTY probe. No subject was added, and the claude process count stays 9.
Transcript echo read uninstrumented: verify now reads /context's stdout tag from the transcript end in the same uninstrumented way. An unreadable end skips only that paste.
The verify-lines-carry-no-content and verify-lines-redacted decisions apply to the new local-command-context step line. It carries only the row id and pass or fail.

Ledger contents never logged: the stamps file entry gains the local-command-context row and measured.typed_probe.context_latency_ms. This is additive, and it is merged by replacing the version's entry whole.

The ledger-stamps parse-rejected row and the unreadable-ledger-means-unverified decisions: a stamp lacking the 25th row, or with it failing, reads as an unverified CLI on every binary built after this chunk. The live home's 24-row stamp is among those stamps.

Indirectly, the unverified-CLI readings (the run log cli_verified field, the unverified-cli refusals of answer and dialog, the run.version_gate span) now apply to any version not re-stamped with 25 rows.

CI verify against the fake agent only, and real-CLI verify never in CI: the fake's --framing echo now takes the /context probe literal. Run B's /context was read on the real CLI only by the test-only live rig, outside CI.

verify is the only stamps writer: the test-only live rig keeps the stamp verify wrote in its scratch home and seeds it into a wrapped start's scratch ledger. It copies that stamp and writes none of its own.
No telemetry from screen content: the test-only rig reads the attribute words of drawn hint cells past the cursor's cell, never their text. This is a test reading and no product telemetry.

Wrapped claude internals and transcripts are not a contract: /context's stdout tag and the absence of a UserPromptSubmit were measured on claude 2.1.328 alone, and nothing is claimed for another version.
Recorded fixtures are no telemetry source: every stamped recorded set stamps 25 of 25 over the fake with no new recording and no change to the set of stamped versions.
